card.name: Doctrine words in Christian religious text
card.fires_on: Nouns for religious teaching or belief, such as truth, teaching, doctrine, word and law. They appear in Christian writing that cites scripture, often right after "the" or an adjective.

modes.label: Truth and word
modes.description: Words like truth, word or law after "the" in scripture-based passages.
modes.example: opposers of the<< truth>>, and deceivers of man.

modes.label: Teaching and doctrine
modes.description: Words for church or biblical teaching, often followed by "of" and a name or institution.
modes.example: is inwardly bound to obey the authoritative<< teaching>> of the Church
